evals.prompt: where can i find a copy of Deep Work by Cal Newport? want to buy it but also grab the epub to add to my RAG library
evals.expected_output: A grouped list of links for 'Deep Work' by Cal Newport: retailer/buy links (Amazon, Bookshop.org, AbeBooks), search links (Google, Google Books, Open Library, WorldCat), and an Anna's Archive link with a note about the avangarde-rag provisioning workflow (drop EPUB in inbox/, run process.py).
expectations: Output includes an Amazon (or equivalent major retailer) search link for 'Deep Work'
Output includes a Bookshop.org or AbeBooks link (indie/used retailer)
Output includes an Anna's Archive (or equivalent EPUB source) link
Output explains or links the RAG provisioning next step (drop EPUB in avangarde-rag/inbox/, run process.py) since the user explicitly asked to add it to their RAG library
Output includes at least one general search link (Google, Google Books, Open Library, or WorldCat)
Links are grouped by intent (buy vs. search vs. provision), not a flat undifferentiated list

evals.prompt:
just ran /book-hunt on 'stoicism' and got this shopping list back:

🔴 High: Letters from a Stoic — Seneca
🟡 Medium: Discourses — Epictetus
🟢 Low: Enchiridion — Epictetus

can you get me links for all of these so I can actually go buy/grab them?
evals.expected_output: Links for all three titles, each grouped into buy/search/provision sections, with author attached to each (Seneca, Epictetus, Epictetus). Should not skip any of the three books or merge them into one query.
expectations: Output includes a distinct link block for all three titles: 'Letters from a Stoic', 'Discourses', and 'Enchiridion'
Each title's links are attributed to the correct author (Seneca for Letters from a Stoic; Epictetus for both Discourses and Enchiridion)
Titles are not merged into a single combined search query — each book gets its own set of links
Output includes a buy link (Amazon, Bookshop.org, or AbeBooks) for each of the three titles
Output includes an EPUB/archive provisioning link (e.g. Anna's Archive) for each of the three titles
